description: A wrapper that makes a view respond to touches by decreasing its opacity when pressed. For more advanced touch handling, consider using Pressable.

pressEffect: When pressed, the opacity of the wrapped view decreases, dimming it
Opacity change is handled via an Animated.View wrapper
Be aware that using Animated.View can affect layout
howItWorks.tip: For more extensive and future-proof touch handling, use Pressable instead

activeOpacity.description: Opacity of the view when touch is active

nextFocusDown.description: View that receives focus when navigating down

nextFocusForward.description: View that receives focus when navigating forward

nextFocusLeft.description: View that receives focus when navigating left

nextFocusRight.description: View that receives focus when navigating right

nextFocusUp.description: View that receives focus when navigating up

ref.description: Ref setter assigned to the element node when mounted

notes: TouchableOpacity inherits all props from TouchableWithoutFeedback
Use activeOpacity to customize press effect
Better for simple tap interactions, not for complex gestures
